facts.label: Aprender sozinho
facts.sub: Use himself, herself e themselves para dizer quem fez algo: He taught himself guitar. By himself quer dizer sozinho.

facts.label: Aprendeu sozinho
facts.sub: Use taught himself ou taught herself para dizer que alguém aprendeu sem professor: He taught himself guitar. O verbo teach é irregular: teach, taught. O pronome combina com quem aprendeu.

facts.label: Sozinho
facts.sub: Use by himself ou by herself para dizer sozinho, sem ajuda: He learned by himself. She tuned it by herself. Também existe on his own, com quase o mesmo sentido.

pages.title: A music room · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy Friday night in Nashville. Finn has a small music room in his house. Three guitars hang on the wall. His friend Tom looks at them with interest. A small amp stands near the window. Finn starts to tell a family story.

“Tom, my brother taught himself guitar when he was twelve.” says Finn. “Really? Did he take lessons, or did he learn by himself?” says Tom. “By himself. He watched videos and practiced every night.” says Finn.
